title: Science wing escape plan
goal: A practitioner can read this escape plan at a glance: Science wing escape plan.

rubric.must: A visible YOU ARE HERE marker, legend, and two marked exits are present.
Primary and secondary routes visibly lead from the marker to separate exits.
A reader can visually follow the principal flow or relationship from beginning to end.
Key labels remain legible and attached to the correct visible elements.
Lines and symbols do not visually imply unintended connections.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the evacuation/iso exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The drawing clearly presents the Science wing escape plan with a central YOU ARE HERE marker, two distinct green routes leading in opposite directions to separately marked west and east exits, legible room and safety labels, and a complete legend. No material visible defect or unintended connection is apparent.

items.evidence: A prominent blue YOU ARE HERE marker is visible in the corridor; the right-side legend is visible; both corridor ends have green final-exit symbols and EXIT labels.
The primary route uses right-pointing arrows from the marker to the east exit, while the alternative route uses left-pointing arrows from the marker to the west exit.
The continuous green corridor route and directional arrowheads make both evacuation paths immediately traceable from the marker to their exits.

The plan title, Classroom 1–3, Science Lab, Library, CORRIDOR, YOU ARE HERE, EXIT, ASSEMBLY POINT, ABC extinguisher marking, and legend entries are visibly legible and associated with the correct symbols.
Routes remain confined to the corridor and terminate visibly at the two exit symbols; doors, the library opening, safety equipment, and assembly point do not imply unintended route connections.
